Definition: of Hebrew origin (H4428 with pronominal suffix, my king); Melchi (i.e. Malki), the name of two Israelites:--Melchi.
BiblicalUsage: Melchi is a name carried by two men in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, one the son of Janna and one the son of Addi. Luke 3:24 names Melchi the son of Janna, and Luke 3:28 names Melchi the son of Addi, both links in the line that runs back to David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy is the gospel in names: every link, even one we know nothing else about, holds the line to Christ.
